entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker hunter and last of Skalla who uses the Arkbow to turn a captured monstrosaur against the vampires of Luneau, then leaves Ixalan for Shiv to find a dragon to use against Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Baron of Vernot
entities.description: A vampire nobleman and scientist of Luneau who forces Vivien to demonstrate the Arkbow and is bitten in half by the monstrosaur.

entities.name: The Arkbow
entities.description: A relic that preserves dying creatures and summons them at their peak; it bursts the guard who tries to wield it and bonds to Vivien alone.

entities.name: Monstrosaur
entities.description: A dying dinosaur captured and vivisected by the baron; Vivien captures its spirit in the Arkbow and summons it to destroy the baron and Luneau's palace.

entities.name: King Lucard
entities.description: The vampire king of Luneau, attacked by an enlarged spider during Vivien's escape.

entities.name: Luneau
entities.description: The vampire city of Ixalan, whose palace, ballroom, menagerie and cultural district are wrecked by Vivien and her summoned beasts.

entities.name: Royal Palace
entities.description: King Lucard's palace in Luneau, which collapses during Vivien's rampage.

entities.name: Royal Menagerie
entities.description: The palace's collection of captive animals, whose inhabitants Vivien enlarges and frees.

entities.name: The Nuns
entities.description: The baron's magic-using nuns who conjure the barrier around Vivien, numb the monstrosaur and maintain the containment area.

entities.name: Legion of the Dusk
entities.description: The vampire elite of Luneau, who prefer its sultry climate.

entities.name: The Proprietor
entities.description: A vampire cafe owner in Luneau's cultural district who eavesdrops on two officers before the animal stampede reaches his street.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The dragon planeswalker who destroyed Skalla; Vivien hopes to learn his destruction by studying dragons.

entities.name: Skalla
entities.description: Vivien's home plane, now destroyed; she is its last shaman.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane of Luneau, which Vivien leaves.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: The dragon-ruled plane Vivien planeswalks to at the end.

entities.name: Shivan dragons
entities.description: Dragons of Shiv whose names the Ghitu elders only whispered; Vivien intends to lure one.

entities.name: Ghitu
entities.description: A people of Shiv whose elders feared saying the Shivan dragons' names.

events.summary: Vivien reflects that her description of how the Arkbow works was true, and that she is the last of Skalla who can perform the ritual.
events.quote: But now Vivien was the last of Skalla.

events.summary: The baron's minions assemble a containment contraption around the dying monstrosaur and the nuns conjure a barrier; Vivien steps inside.
events.quote: More of the nuns were called to the room, and humming a couplet of chords, they conjured a shimmering barrier.

events.summary: Vivien demands anesthetics for the monstrosaur, and the nuns numb it into a deep sleep at the baron's order.
Vivien performs the ritual: the Arkbow opens and she draws the monstrosaur's spirit into it.
The baron makes a guard try the Arkbow; it bursts his body, proving it obeys only Vivien, and the baron refuses to accept it.
events.quote: A minute spasm of those meaty digits, and his body burst outward.

events.summary: Vivien grows a spider from the guard's pocket with her magic and it leaps at King Lucard, causing chaos and loosening the nuns' hold on her prison.
events.quote: Alarmed by its growth, the arachnid turned and launched itself at the king.

events.summary: Vivien looses an arrow that summons the monstrosaur whole and vengeful, and it rampages through the ballroom, tearing through the ceiling.
events.quote: The arrow buried itself in the wall, and the ethereal monstrosaur tore itself loose, roaring

events.summary: The monstrosaur bites the Baron of Vernot in half, killing him.
events.quote: the two halves of what was once the Baron of Vernot fell quietly, messily to the ground

events.summary: Vivien follows the monstrosaur through the palace and enlarges and frees the animals of the Royal Menagerie, who attack their handlers.
events.quote: Vivien ran her magic through a family of wildebeests, stoking their cells until the creatures grew large enough to smash through their confinement.

events.summary: In a gallery of nobles, Vivien declares the end of Luneau and enlarges a vampire girl's pet raptor, which devours its owner.
events.quote: Then, without any reservation, it twitched forward and shut its jaws around the vampire's skull, teeth crunching through the vertebrae.

events.summary: The freed menagerie stampedes through the gallery and the Royal Palace collapses.
events.quote: Soon enough, the Royal Palace fell, dust pluming into the air.

events.summary: In a cafe in the cultural district, two officers grumble that the baron is studying the Arkbow and could make them redundant, just before the stampede arrives.
events.quote: If he succeeds at deciphering that stupid artifact, we'd be out of a job.

events.summary: Enormous dinosaurs and beasts flood Luneau's streets, wrecking buildings, as Vivien rides a monstrosaur's head.
events.quote: these creatures weren't just unexpectedly everywhere, they were each three times their usual sizes, too massive to be plausible.

events.summary: Vivien surveys the anarchy she unleashed and resolves to secure the Arkbow against theft and find larger prey to hunt.
Vivien decides to harness dragons to learn the secret of destroying Nicol Bolas, and settles on luring a Shivan dragon.
events.quote: Nicol Bolas wasn't the only dragon in the Multiverse.

events.summary: Vivien planeswalks from Ixalan to Shiv.
events.quote: before she flashed into the next plane and felt the hard, hot air of Shiv on her skin

relations.note: Summoned by Vivien, it bites him in two.
relations.quote: the monstrosaur bit down and the two halves of what was once the Baron of Vernot fell quietly, messily to the ground

relations.note: He holds her captive to learn the Arkbow's secrets.
relations.quote: The baron curled his hand into a fist

relations.note: He is a scientist at the king's court who performs the vivisection for the king's entertainment.
relations.quote: You know the Baron of Vernot is studying the device right now

relations.note: They obey his orders to conjure barriers and anesthetize the monstrosaur.

relations.quote: The Arkbow is mine. It won't obey another hand.

relations.note: She seeks the secret of his destruction after he destroyed Skalla.
relations.quote: she might be able to learn the secret to Nicol Bolas's destruction
